meaning:
ὀπώρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Jer.48:32 40:10, 12 (קַיִץ) * ;]
1. late summer, early autumn (the time between the risings of Sirius and Arcturus, i.e. late July, all August and early September).
2. By meton. (as being fruit-time), ripe fruits Rev.18:14 (cf. φθινοπωρινά, Ju 12).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more…
